# Fillfox: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-09 · code 7ebf1707191f · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A free form builder: write a form like a document, share a link, see every answer and where people stopped. Logic, quizzes and signatures included.
**Live:** https://fillfox.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/fillfox · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `fillfox/.claude/skills/fillfox/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py fillfox` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JavaScript (converted 2026-11-08, branch `forms`).** Pages, menus, dialogs and lists are Forms. Four engines
  stay JavaScript in theme/assets, moved unchanged from web/pages: `ff.js` (form model + FF.TEMPLATES; same rules as
  server_code/Logic.py, keep both in step), `ffr.js` (the renderer people fill in), `ff-editor.js` (the WHOLE editor:
  toolbar, Build/Design/Settings/Share, autosave, undo, slash menu, logic and bulk dialogs, QR, embed, team) and
  `ff-results.js` (the Results maths, returning data the Results page draws with RepeatingPanels; also CSV and the #f wiring).
- **Bridge:** `client_code/ff.py` installs `UI.bridge` (UI.api / UI.apiQuiet / UI.upload -> anvil.server.call, JSON text)
  and `UI.toastHook` (-> state.toast). `theme/assets/ff-ui.js` keeps the old core.js helpers the engines use (UI.modal,
  UI.confirm, UI.busy, data-go links). state.set_me also sets `UI.me` (the editor's Settings tab reads ctx.me.email).
- **Components:** `Editor` (FF.editor; a tab switch = a new address = a new Edit page, the old engine saves in destroy();
  `window.UI_EDITOR_READY` for tests), `FormView` (FF.render: template try-outs and the public #f page via
  FF.publicForm.mount, which keeps the per-visit token in localStorage `fillfox.tok.<slug>`), `Spark` (FF.spark SVG).
- **#f has no Shell** (no header/footer, like before); `?preview=1` / `?embed=1` are read from the hash by FF.publicForm.flags.
- Templates picked while signed out wait in storage `fillfox.pendingTemplate`; Pages/Forms creates them after sign-up.
- Old page CSS aimed at `span`s hits Label text: use child selectors (`.fm-top > div > span`); Label text inherits its role's font.
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` only (every address signed out / member / admin, desktop + phone).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback

- **payments**: form→forms, token:str, session:str, status:str, amount:num, currency:str, email:str, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Forms, Payments
- **reports**: form→forms, reason:str, details:str, email:str, created:dt, status:str, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Fill, Forms
- **responses**: form→forms, token:str, status:str, answers:obj, score:num, reached:num, meta:obj, started:dt, submitted:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Fill, Forms, Results
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
